reported.title: RPM scaling wrong by ~10x
reported.description: readRpm returns millivolts (raw*5000/1023) but the spec is 1 mV per rpm, so the printed value is ~10x too high (e.g. 2000 rpm reads ~2000 mV→~9775). Must divide by 1 mV/rpm, i.e. rpm = mV.

reported.title: Serial format wrong
reported.description: Prints 'rpm: <n>' with a space and lowercase, but spec requires 'RPM:<n>' with no space after the colon.

reported.title: Min/max never reset per second
reported.description: rpmMin/rpmMax accumulate over the whole run instead of being reset each second, so the per-second 'spindle min/max' line reports lifetime extremes, not the current second's.

reported.title: Warn threshold uses unscaled value
reported.description: updateWarn compares the millivolt value against WARN_RPM=2000, so the lamp lights at ~200 rpm instead of 2000 rpm.

exposing_checks.behaviour: serial lines matching '^RPM:' every 1000 ms (RPM: lines)
serial values for 'RPM:(-?[0-9.]+)' match the stimulus (tolerance 50) (rpm value)

judge_input.spec:
- Tach input on A5 at 1 mV per rpm; over-speed lamp on D9; mute on D3 (pull-up).
- Print `RPM:<n>` with no space after the colon once per second (1000 ms ±120 ms).
- Printed rpm must stay within ±50 of the injected tach value.
- Light D9 when rpm is at or above 2000 while mute is released.
- While D3 is held LOW, keep D9 OFF regardless of rpm.
- Each second also print `spindle min=<n> max=<n>` after the RPM line.
